text:
Situation: Enalapril maleate has been on FDA's drug shortage list for 91 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 507 units (44 days on hand at 11.4 units per day). Corvale General holds 263 units (19 days on hand at 14 units per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 of Bryant Ranch PrePack ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI with six observations including lack of a written stability program and complaint investigation deficiencies. Subsequent inspections of the same plant through 2026-07-16 have all been classified VAI. The drug has not been listed on FDA's shortage list since 2019-03-29.

Our position: Current inventory covers 19–44 days depending on site. The rule-based best option is A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI on 2026-08-12. Four additional suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with A-S Medication Solutions; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Amici Pharma, Inc as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Bausch Health US LLC as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Bausch Health US, LLC as quaternary source; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Chartwell RX, LLC as fifth source; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No action that delays procurement beyond current days-on-hand thresholds.
